title: Trace + Log Correlation
description: Surface trace_id on both spans and logs so you can jump between a trace and the log lines it produced.

panels.title: Recent error logs (with trace_id)
panels.description: Click a trace_id row to pivot to the matching trace. Logs carry trace_id automatically when emitted inside a span.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, service, message, trace_id FROM "default" WHERE level = 'error' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC

panels.title: Slowest spans (with trace_id)
panels.description: Copy a trace_id to the Traces view to inspect the full waterfall.

queries.query: SELECT trace_id, service_name, operation_name, CAST(duration AS DOUBLE)/1000 AS duration_ms, span_status FROM "checkout-api" ORDER BY duration DESC

panels.title: Top traces by log count
panels.description: Traces that emitted the most log lines — useful for spotting chatty failure paths.

queries.query: SELECT trace_id AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE trace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20
